title: Oozy Buttery Middle Eastern Oats Falafel
description: A buttery, crisp, and indulgent Middle Eastern dish featuring oats, served in a ramekin and grilled to perfection using a robata grill, with a Mediterranean twist in the form of falafel.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a food processor, combine oats, chickpeas, onion, garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and process until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl and stir in the melted butter and lemon juice until a thick batter forms.
Divide the batter into 6 equal portions and shape each portion into a ball, then flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Place each falafel in a ramekin and brush the tops with a little extra melted butter.
Place the ramekins on the robata grill and cook for 12 minutes, or until the falafel are golden brown and crispy on the outside.
Flip the falafel over and cook for an additional 8 minutes, or until the other side is also golden brown.
Remove the falafel from the grill and serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
